candidates.reason: Unit tests for the shutdown signal handlers that this change rewrites. They build a bare AsyncCrawlerProcess and assert exactly what the handler schedules on the event loop. test_signal_kill_reactorless_without_main_task currently asserts loop.call_soon_threadsafe is never called; after the change the handler schedules the kill notice there, so this test must change, and new assertions about the notice being scheduled on the loop belong in this class.

End-to-end tests that drive the same handlers by sending SIGINT to a real crawler process and assert the user-visible shutdown notices ("shutting down gracefully", "forcing unclean shutdown") and their order on stderr. They are the observable-behaviour check for moving the notice out of the signal handler into the reactor/loop thread.
